title: Naturality of both projection-formula coefficient arrows
statement: Use exactly the ringed-topos, derived-functor and representative data of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows]. For bounded cochain complexes F and G with strict-perfect coefficient packages P and Q, and any cochain map f:F to G, let A(f)=TR(1_RF(E),Q(f)) and B(f)=RF(TS(1_E,LF(Q(f)))). If pi_F,rho_F and pi_G,rho_G are the pairs of that definition, then A(f) followed by pi_G equals pi_F followed by B(f), and B(f) followed by rho_G equals rho_F followed by A(f). No compatibility of f with the packages is assumed.

source.place: Naturality and finite-free retract argument, read with definition 1264

proof.text: The first arrow is an app of the natural transformation rightAdjointProjectionMap of the derived tensor comparison. Apply its naturality in the coefficient morphism Q(f).

Naturality of tensorPullbackTotal follows on each total-complex coprojection from naturality of the ordinary tensor comparison. Its inverse is natural. Apply naturality on both sides of the ordinary complex adjunction Hom bijection to obtain naturality of tensorAdjunctionTotal; invert the resulting square using tensorAdjunctionTotal_isIso.

For the mixed tensor representative of A and F, choose a flat K-flat resolution p:P to A. Its defining square after precomposition by TR(Q(p),1) is its specification. Naturality of rR.inv and functoriality of total tensor make these specifications commute with F to G. Cancel the invertible TR(Q(p),1). Repeat for S.

Naturality of epsilon and eta induces naturality of the complex derived comparison maps. Invert the squares used backwards in the definition of eA and eB. Combine with mixed-representative naturality to obtain natural squares for eC and eB. Substitute those squares and the inverse-total square into rho=eB.hom followed by Q(s) followed by eC.inv. Associativity and functoriality give the reverse-arrow square. Packages occur only in proof arguments, so no compatibility of f with either package is required.

lean.statement:
theorem ringedProjectionFormula_coefficient_naturality
    (F G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (P : StrictPerfectCoefficientPackage _ F) (Q : StrictPerfectCoefficientPackage _ G)
    (hbF : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero (F.X r))
    (hbG : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ r : ℤ, r < a ∨ b < r → IsZero (G.X r)) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    let pair := pairFamily
    let pF := pair F P hbF
    let pG := pair G Q hbG
    Amap f ≫ pG.1 = pF.1 ≫ Bmap f ∧
      Bmap f ≫ pG.2 = pF.2 ≫ Amap f
